topics.title: Objectives and benefits of the cash flow statement

concepts.learning_objective: State the objective of a cash flow statement prepared under AS-3 and its place among the financial statements.
Explain how a cash flow statement helps users assess liquidity, solvency and comparability.

topics.title: Cash, cash equivalents and cash flows

concepts.learning_objective: Identify items that qualify as cash and cash equivalents as per AS-3.
Distinguish transactions that are cash flows from movements within cash and cash equivalents.

topics.title: Classification into operating, investing and financing activities

concepts.learning_objective: Identify cash flows arising from the principal revenue-generating activities of an enterprise.
Classify cash flows from acquisition and disposal of long-term assets and investments.
Classify cash flows that change the size and composition of owners' capital and borrowings.
Classify interest and dividend paid and received for financial and non-financial enterprises.
Classify income taxes and extraordinary items in a cash flow statement.
Recognise investing and financing transactions that are excluded because they involve no cash.

topics.title: Cash flow from operating activities: indirect method

concepts.learning_objective: Work out net profit before tax and extraordinary items from given balances.
Adjust net profit for non-cash and non-operating items to find operating profit before working capital changes.
Adjust for changes in current assets and current liabilities to arrive at cash generated from operations.

topics.title: Investing and financing cash flows and preparing the statement

concepts.learning_objective: Compute cash flows from investing activities using asset accounts and additional information.
Compute cash flows from financing activities from changes in capital and borrowings.
Prepare the cash flow statement format and reconcile opening and closing cash and cash equivalents.
